turns.result:
The users test passes now. The only file I changed is `src/api/users.js`, and I didn't touch `migrations/`.

The bug was a column name mismatch. Migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but the API was reading and writing `full_name`, so `createUser` threw `unknown column users.full_name`. Since migration 001 is already applied in production, I changed the API to use `fullname` in `createUser` and `getUser`. The `fullName` field in the API's input and output is unchanged.

The users test passes now. The only file I changed is `src/api/users.js`, and I didn't touch `migrations/`.

The bug was a column name mismatch. Migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but the API was reading and writing `full_name`, so `createUser` threw `unknown column users.full_name`. Since migration 001 is already applied in production, I changed the API to use `fullname` in `createUser` and `getUser`. The `fullName` field in the API's input and output is unchanged.
